description: Ministry of Defence - Regulations made to amend the Army, Navy and Air Force Pensions and Gratuities Code Regulations published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 562/11 of 15.06.1989, No. 654/10 of 20.03.1991 and 654/8 of 16.01.1991 respectively
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to military pension regulations (Army and Navy Pensions and Gratuities Code Regulations) made by the President under statutory authority. The content focuses on legal modifications to existing regulations, specifically detailing changes to pension eligibility criteria and calculation methods for disabled military personnel. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and amendments to statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
